description: This file implements functions and classes related to disabling torch functions in PyTorch, including Python C API bindings for context managers and dispatch key guards.

classes.name: DisableTorchFunctionSubclass
classes.description: A Python object representing a subclass used for disabling torch functions within a context.

classes.name: DisableTorchFunction
classes.description: A Python object representing a context for disabling all torch functions.

methods.name: DisableTorchFunctionSubclass__enter
methods.description: Enters the context, disables torch functions by setting the TLS state.

methods.name: DisableTorchFunctionSubclass__exit
methods.description: Exits the context, restores previous TLS state.

methods.name: DisableTorchFunction__enter
methods.description: Enters the disable torch function context, sets the TLS state to disable all.

methods.name: DisableTorchFunction__exit
methods.description: Exits the disable torch function context, restores previous TLS state.

methods.name: THPModule_disable_torch_function
methods.description: Python API to disable torch functions for a given callable and optional types, args, kwargs.

methods.name: THPModule_disable_torch_dispatch
methods.description: Python API to disable torch dispatch for a given callable and optional args.

methods.name: THPModule_has_torch_function
methods.description: Checks if any argument in a sequence has __torch_function__ attribute.

methods.name: THPModule_has_torch_function_unary
methods.description: Checks if a single object has __torch_function__ attribute.

methods.name: THPModule_has_torch_function_variadic
methods.description: Checks if any object in a list of arguments has __torch_function__ attribute.
